thesis: CRVL is a clean uptrend pulling back to its SMA20 inside a risk-off tape, which is relative strength when QQQ is below both its averages. Fundamentals are high quality and improving: growth is accelerating, margins and ROE are solid, cash far exceeds debt, and dilution risk is low. The entry zone 81.5-83.2 does not chase the 52-week high, the stop sits just under the 79.19 swing low, and the target at the prior high gives about 2.2 reward/risk. Earnings are 61 business days away, so no event risk falls inside a swing horizon. The main weaknesses are a rich valuation, a market that is risk-off, and unknown content of the just-filed earnings 8-K, so this is a moderate-conviction setup rather than a high-conviction one.
